name: Aluminium Ribbed
review: Regular broad metallic ribs; unlike fine brushed grain and hammered dents.

name: Calf Hide
review: Warm tan smooth hide, distinct from grey Dusty Concrete.

name: Carbon Fibre
review: Dark alternating woven fibre cells.

name: Coated Metal
review: Distressed blue coated sheet; unlike uniform blue Powder Coat.

name: Bare Concrete
review: Dark smooth cement with sparse mottling.

name: Clean Concrete
review: Pale panel joints and localized pits distinguish it from Plain Concrete.

name: Dusty Concrete
review: Grey-beige fine dusty cement; Calf Hide was warmed to separate this pair.

name: Plain Concrete
review: Dense coarse speckled cement; distinguishable from Clean Concrete panels.

name: Denim
review: Blue twill weave; fabric grain and roughness differ from Powder Coat.

name: Knit Wool
review: Dark knitted loops, distinct from cream napped Wool and open Hessian weave.

name: Rough Fabric
review: Large open tan Hessian weave.

name: Suit Tweed
review: Fine grey herringbone weave.

name: Gravel Ground
review: Dense small sandy gravel; Pebbles has large smooth rounded stones.

name: Brushed Iron
review: Fine directional brushed iron; distinct from smooth Polished Iron.

name: Galvanized Steel
review: Dark oxidized corrugated zinc sheet; Painted Steel has pale striped coating.

name: Hammered Metal
review: Large rounded hammer dents.

name: Powder Coat
review: Even blue rough coating; Grainy Plastic moved to green.

name: Raw Iron
review: Blue-black mill scale with broad worn exposed iron patches.

name: Rough Iron
review: Warm dark cast iron with coarse granular relief and high roughness.

name: Polished Iron
review: Smooth dark mirror highlights; no brushed abrasion or mill scale.

name: Coarse Leather
review: Dark brown coarse pores; distinct from reddish soft and faded worn hide.

name: Soft Leather
review: Reddish brown soft wrinkles; Worn Leather was faded/desaturated to separate it.

name: Worn Leather
review: Faded cool grey-brown worn hide, distinct from reddish Soft Leather and dark Coarse Leather.

name: Mortar Brick Wall
review: Large orange brickwork with mortar joints.

name: Pebbles
review: Large grey rounded river pebbles.

name: Grainy Plastic
review: Sage green granular polymer, distinct from blue Powder Coat and beige materials.

name: Striped Plastic
review: Orange molded broad ribs; unlike silicone smooth reddish matte surface.

name: Diamond Plate Plastic
review: Dark embossed diagonal plastic pattern.

name: Coarse Rust
review: Even fine-scale orange-brown corrosion.

name: Fine Rust
review: Irregular bare pale metal amid red corrosion; unlike even Coarse Rust.

name: Silicone
review: Muted warm red soft smooth dielectric.

name: Painted Steel
review: Pale painted corrugation, distinct from dark galvanized finish.

name: Rough Steel
review: Cool steel with directional abrasion and varying satin roughness.

name: Worn Rusty Steel
review: Dark flaking and mottled damaged steel with broad wear patches.

name: Cherry Wood
review: Pale cherry veneer grain; visible at 1K. Walnut was darkened.

name: Rough Wood
review: Weathered directional timber grain and cracks.

name: Walnut Wood
review: Oiled dark walnut tint preserves original veneer grain; distinct from pale Cherry Wood.

name: Wool
review: Plain cream napped fleece: wool-like surface approximation, without the checker weave of wool_boucle.

name: Reptile Scales
review: Large green polygonal scales.

name: Leaf Litter
review: Recognizable green/brown leaves on soil.

name: Lichen Rock
review: Crusted rocky mottling; unlike leafy ground.

name: Rubber
review: Very dark rough matte dielectric.

name: Gold
review: Smooth yellow reflective metal.

name: Copper
review: Smooth red-orange reflective metal.

name: Marble
review: Pale stone veining; grain differs from hides/fleece/plastic.

name: Stone Wall
review: Coarse blocks and mortar in irregular masonry.

name: Ceramic Tiles
review: Grey-brown tile seams and glaze.
